reviewedCapabilityAlerts.rationale: AIWG is an orchestration CLI whose documented workflows intentionally invoke local tools after user approval.
reviewedCapabilityAlerts.revalidateWhen: Shell execution boundaries, approval gates, or command dispatch code changes.

reviewedCapabilityAlerts.rationale: AIWG installs and manages project-owned workflow, agent, skill, and context files.
reviewedCapabilityAlerts.revalidateWhen: Install roots, path validation, or write authorization behavior changes.

reviewedCapabilityAlerts.rationale: AIWG retrieves explicitly selected public resources and serves opt-in local integrations.
reviewedCapabilityAlerts.revalidateWhen: Remote origins, transport policy, or network-facing commands change.

reviewedCapabilityAlerts.rationale: The CLI reads documented environment configuration while secret values remain excluded from reports and logs.
reviewedCapabilityAlerts.revalidateWhen: Environment-variable handling or redaction policy changes.

reviewedCapabilityAlerts.rationale: Public, versioned web resources are a supported AIWG distribution channel.
reviewedCapabilityAlerts.revalidateWhen: Resource URL allowlisting or release distribution changes.

reviewedCapabilityAlerts.rationale: Hono Node adapter used by aiwg serve and the MCP HTTP transport; network use is its purpose.
reviewedCapabilityAlerts.revalidateWhen: @hono/node-server version changes (new artifact hash) or AIWG starts using the flagged capability differently.

reviewedCapabilityAlerts.rationale: CLI argument parser; reads package metadata and resolves executable subcommands from disk.
reviewedCapabilityAlerts.revalidateWhen: commander version changes (new artifact hash) or AIWG starts using the flagged capability differently.

reviewedCapabilityAlerts.rationale: child_process.spawn runs only for executable subcommands (command(name, desc) with an executable file); AIWG registers none (no executable subcommands in src, tools or bin).
reviewedCapabilityAlerts.revalidateWhen: commander version changes (new artifact hash) or AIWG starts using the flagged capability differently.

reviewedCapabilityAlerts.rationale: File watcher used by watch and housekeeper jobs on user-selected project paths.
reviewedCapabilityAlerts.revalidateWhen: chokidar version changes (new artifact hash) or AIWG starts using the flagged capability differently.

reviewedCapabilityAlerts.rationale: Drop-in fs wrapper that retries EMFILE; file access on paths the caller already chose.
reviewedCapabilityAlerts.revalidateWhen: graceful-fs version changes (new artifact hash) or AIWG starts using the flagged capability differently.

reviewedCapabilityAlerts.rationale: Pattern matching over project files the caller already selected.
reviewedCapabilityAlerts.revalidateWhen: glob version changes (new artifact hash) or AIWG starts using the flagged capability differently.

reviewedCapabilityAlerts.rationale: False positive: the flagged fetch( is the bundled lru-cache LRUCache.fetch() method (in-memory cache), not a network call. Verified in dist/commonjs/index.min.js 14.0.2 (both fetch( matches are LRUCache.fetch/memo).
reviewedCapabilityAlerts.revalidateWhen: glob version changes (new artifact hash) or AIWG starts using the flagged capability differently.

reviewedCapabilityAlerts.rationale: False positive: the flagged fetch() is the spinner frame accessor and the URLs are documentation links. Verified in dist/index.cjs 8.3.3.
reviewedCapabilityAlerts.revalidateWhen: listr2 version changes (new artifact hash) or AIWG starts using the flagged capability differently.

reviewedCapabilityAlerts.rationale: WebSocket library used by the AIWG cockpit/pty bridge; network use is its purpose.
reviewedCapabilityAlerts.revalidateWhen: ws version changes (new artifact hash) or AIWG starts using the flagged capability differently.

reviewedCapabilityAlerts.rationale: GHSA-mrhx-c7xc-m3w5 in the zod 3.25.76 copy nested under @fortemi/core, which pins zod ^3.24. AIWG itself uses zod 4.6.7 and passes no schemas across the boundary. Waiting on a Fortemi release with zod 4.
reviewedCapabilityAlerts.revalidateWhen: @fortemi/core publishes a zod 4 release, or AIWG starts passing untrusted input into Fortemi tool schemas.

reviewedCapabilityAlerts.rationale: CVE-2026-104850 / GHSA-6qxp-vccf-f47h (OAuth issuer binding) in @modelcontextprotocol/client 2.0.0, reached only through the @aiwg/flue peer @flue/runtime 2.3.0, which pins the client exactly. AIWG uses no MCP OAuth client (no authProvider, withOAuth, auth() or fetchToken()); the root @modelcontextprotocol/sdk resolves to a patched release. Waiting on a Flue runtime on client >= 2.2.0. Operator decision 2026-11-08.
reviewedCapabilityAlerts.revalidateWhen: @flue/runtime publishes a release depending on @modelcontextprotocol/client >= 2.2.0, or AIWG starts using an MCP OAuth client.

reviewedCapabilityAlerts.rationale: Socket unstableOwnership flag on tslib 2.9.1 (published 2026-10-30 by microsoft1es, a listed maintainer), reached through @flue/runtime -> @earendil-works/pi-ai -> AWS SDK. Publisher is a known Microsoft account; no code or capability finding. Operator decision 2026-11-08.
reviewedCapabilityAlerts.revalidateWhen: tslib publishes a new version, its maintainer list changes, or Socket reports a code or capability finding for it.
